function.arguments:
{"claim_id": "c3", "code": "import json, torch

# Exhaustively compare kernel path (fp32 multiply + one fp16 cast) vs reference path
# (exact double product then one .half()) for quant 0..15, zero 1..16, and every
# positive fp16 scale value in (0, 1/32] (subnormals + normals), using unsigned views.
qz = (torch.arange(16, dtype=torch.float32)[:, None, None]
      - torch.arange(1, 17, dtype=torch.float32)[None, :, None])  # (16,16,1) q-z, exact
# all positive fp16 values: bits 1..0x7BFF
bits = torch.arange(1, 0x7C00, dtype=torch.int16).to(torch.uint16)
vals = bits.view(torch.float16).to(torch.float64)
mask = (vals > 0) & (vals <= 0.03125)
scales = vals[mask]  # fp16 values, exact
S = scales.to(torch.float32)[None, None, :]  # fp16-exact value held in fp32
kern = ((qz * S).to(torch.float16)).view(torch.uint16).to(torch.int64)
ref = ((qz.to(torch.float64) * scales.to(torch.float64)[None, None, :]).to(torch.float16)).view(torch.uint16).to(torch.int64)
mism = (kern != ref)
print(json.dumps({
  "claim": "c3 decoded-weight H16 rounding",
  "n_scales_tested": int(mask.sum().item()),
  "n_subnormal_scales": int((scales.view(torch.uint16) < 0x0400).sum().item()),
  "n_combinations": int(16*16*int(mask.sum().item())),
  "n_mismatches": int(mism.sum().item()),
  "bit_identical": bool(not bool(mism.any().item()))}))", "expected_signal": "n_mismatches==0 over all ~14k scales (incl. subnormals) x 256 q-z combos means the fp32+one-fp16-round path is bit-identical to contract H16; n_mismatches>0 confirms the claim.", "timeout_s": 300}
function.name: run_claim_probe

message.reasoning_content:
c1 and c2 passed → rebutted. c3 probe bug: n_scales_tested=0 — the subnormal bit range was wrong (0x4000 limit means bits < 0x4000 covers only 0..16383, but subnormals in fp16 need bits 1..1023; and normals 0x0400..0x3801 exceed max fp16 0x7BFF... actually filter <=0.03125 with 0x3800 huge values... wait, scales.numel()=0 means filter removed everything — because view(torch.int16) gives signed values, negatives. bits up to 0x3800 > 32767 → negative int16 → negative floats, filtered out. Fix: use torch.uint16 view or restrict range. Rerun c3 with corrected code. Also finalize c1 and c2 now.

Note the c1/c2 probes ran on... sandbox says mode cpu_ulimit, but use_gpu true; likely fine.

Do finalize for t9, t10 (rebutted claims), and launch corrected c3 probe.
